metric_definitions.exact_evidence_recall_at_5: Per-question fraction of expected evidence IDs actually present in returned top5, then macro mean.
metric_definitions.support_hit_at_5: Cases: exact case ID. Other documents: expected document AND all support terms in returned text (case/whitespace normalized). Parent-only content not credited.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_5: Mean reciprocal first support-relevant rank; 0 if not found.
metric_definitions.doctor_packet_expected_text_present_coun: Separate integration diagnostic after context length/source permission filtering; never substitute for raw retrieval recall.

limitations: Holdout has 16 new queries / 12 cases absent from original development qrels; all share the existing corpus and coding document.
Queries and relevance were source-derived by implementation author, not external blinded clinicians; labels are not exhaustive.
Calibration reuses development targets; no tuning in this revision. It is not independent.
Stored source metadata forbids LLM processing for coding documents; their text is withheld from Doctor even when retrieval succeeds.
No clinical diagnosis correctness or note-quality score follows from these retrieval metrics.
